title: Cinimatix
tagline: A decentralized platform that connects filmmakers with investors through token-based proposals. This secure and transparent system empowers creators, democratizes film funding, and brings visionary ideas to life.
description:
Cinimatix bridges the gap between creators and investors in the film industry. Creators, including directors, scriptwriters and animators. This platform addresses the challenges faced by both creators and investors, fostering a vibrant ecosystem where creativity and investment thrive together.

Creators can showcase their projects to a community eager to support them using ETH or preferred tokens. Users can fund these projects, providing essential financial support while actively participating in the creative process.

To enhance engagement and attract investors, Cinimatix features a dynamic thumbnail design contest. Creators can launch contests to generate eye-catching thumbnails, and skilled designers can submit their entries. The community votes for their favorite designs and the winning thumbnail is minted as an NFT. This NFT, displayed in the creator’s dashboard, adds value to the project and rewards both the creator and designer.
how_its_made: Cinimatix integrates Worldcoin ID for secure sign-in and uses its Incognito Actions for unique vote verification, ensuring the integrity of the voting process. It supports multi-chain integration, including Optimum, Base, and Ethereum, and employs Goldman to sync data from smart contracts to a PostgreSQL database, keeping information accurate and up-to-date. The platform also features a rollup implemented using Conduit and uses Blockscout for viewing and confirming transactions, displaying them on the profiles of creators and investors.
